name: Ground News Top Stories
description: A screensaver that cycles through the top stories on ground.news for your region, with each story's photo, summary, number of sources and its left, center and right coverage split. Select Top Stories (Ground News Top Stories) under Screensaver > Screensaver mode.
author: MozKaboom

settings.title: Number of stories
settings.description: How many top stories to cycle through, in the order the ground.news home page shows them.

settings.title: Include Daily Briefing
settings.description: Start with the stories from Ground News' Daily Briefing. The briefing is the same in every edition and is mostly US news. Off shows only your edition's top stories.

settings.title: Time per story
settings.description: How long each story stays on screen.

settings.title: Refresh every
settings.description: How often to load the latest stories from ground.news.

settings.title: Show photos
settings.description: Download each story's photo. Turn off to save data.

settings.title: Show summary
settings.description: Show a short summary under each headline.

settings.title: Show coverage bias
settings.description: Show the left, center and right split of the sources covering each story, when ground.news has one.

settings.title: Show clock
settings.description: Show the time and date in the top right corner.
